channel.title: Livable Telluride — Family & Kids
channel.description: Upcoming storytime, youth programs, and all-ages activities across the Telluride region.

item.title: [Wed, Jun 10] Baby Bop
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Program Room 9:00 AM – 10:00 AM · Baby Bop is a fun, upbeat babywearing dance class designed for caregivers and little ones to move together through easy-to-follow routines. Expect feel-good music, simple choreography, and a supportive atmosphere focused on bonding, movement, and joy — no dance experience required! Baby Bop es una clase de baile divertida y animada, diseñada para que cuidadores y pequeños se muevan juntos mediante rutinas fáciles de seguir. Te espera música alegre, coreografías sencillas y un ambiente de apoyo centrado en el vínculo, el movimiento y la alegría; ¡no se requiere experiencia previa en baile!

item.title: [Wed, Jun 10] Gardening Camp / Campamento de Jardinería
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Wilkinson Public Library 12:30 PM – 3:30 PM · Join us for four fun-filled afternoons of hands-on gardening and learning. Projects and activities will include: planting a garden, garden decor crafts, earthworm play, storytimes, fairy and gnome play, and more! Who: Open to children ages 6-12 who can participate independently (without a parent or caregiver present). Registration : Space is limited- please only register if your child can attend all four days. Final Day: Celebrate with a public "ribbon cutting" garden reveal during the last hour of camp- friends and family welcome! What to Bring: A full belly Water bottle Sunhat & sunscreen Extra snacks Some snacks will be provided. All other items are the caregiver's responsibility. We can't wait to get garden with you! ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ¡Únanse a nosotros para cuarto tardes llenas de diversion con jardinería y aprendizaje! …

item.title: [Wed, Jun 10] Teen Movie and Ice Cream Club
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Teen Area 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM · Join us every Wednesday this summer for Teen Movie and Ice Cream Club. We will watch a movie on the teen TV with free ice cream available!
